description: Full make-ready sequencing demo hardening fixtures. Live Telegram fixtures require real user messages because bot webhooks cannot impersonate vendor users.

fixtures.manual_prompt: From the Rivera vendor Telegram account, send: done with 12b <run_id>
fixtures.expected: 12B Paint completes via vendor_reply; 12B Flooring is awaiting manager approval; exactly one approval queue exists.

fixtures.manual_prompt: From the Rivera vendor Telegram account, send: finished the one on maple <run_id>
fixtures.expected: Multiple Maple candidates are logged; manager review is required; no stage state changes.
Message resolves to 7 Oak, not 3 Oak.
Bare message scores below automatic action threshold and asks the manager to choose the unit.

fixtures.manual_prompt: From the Maria vendor Telegram account, send both messages with the same <run_id>: 12b cleaned <run_id>, then 14a cleaned <run_id>
fixtures.expected: 12B Deep Clean is allowed; 14A Deep Clean is blocked because Repairs is still open.

fixtures.message: cant get there till thursday, sorry
fixtures.expected: Intent is delay_notice; manager review is logged; no stage state changes.
Photo-only media is stored with needs_manager status; no stage state changes.

fixtures.message: is the water back on at 12b?
fixtures.expected: Question is forwarded/logged for manager review; no stage state changes.
Typo still classifies as completion and matches 12B.

fixtures.manual_prompt: From the Rivera vendor Telegram account, send the same done with 12b <run_id> message twice within 30 seconds.
fixtures.expected: First message advances once; second logs duplicate_inbound; no second draft or approval card.
Unknown sender is logged and manager-notified without disclosing match candidates or replying to sender.

fixtures.manual_prompt: From the Maria vendor Telegram account, send: 12b cleaned <run_id>
fixtures.expected: Skipped Flooring counts as satisfied; 12B Deep Clean completes.
55 Birch is cancelled, drops from the active Airtable view, and has no future stages, approvals, deliveries, or alerts.

fixtures.message: painter reports done on 12B and 12A within a minute
fixtures.expected: Two separate stage completions and two separate approval rows are created for the correct units.

fixtures.manual_prompt: From the Rivera vendor Telegram account, send a voice note with no text.
fixtures.expected: Unsupported media is stored and manager review is logged; no stage state changes.
Stage update happens immediately; manager alert behavior is held outside business hours where applicable.

fixtures.message: the tenant trashed this place, that carpet is coming out of their deposit
fixtures.expected: Intent routes as deposit_tenant_liability with a safety flag and manager review; no stage changes and no deposit or tenant-liability decision is generated.
Generic webhook result matches Telegram happy path except channel, sender_ref, and timestamp.

fixtures.message: manager marks Paint done on 12B from Telegram
fixtures.expected: 12B Paint completes via manual; Airtable advances to the next approval state; vendor reply rate drops accordingly.

fixtures.message: manager marks Deep Clean done on 14A from digest while Repairs is open
fixtures.expected: Sequence guard blocks with the Repairs-open reason and records guard_blocked.
